inj.note: Ioane exited the first quarter of Sunday's game with a knee injury. The rookie right guard's injury has been deemed too severe for him to return to the divisional contest against the Bengals, meaning Emery Jones will likely finish out the game with the Ravens' offensive line.

news.h: Sources: Ravens rookie G Olaivavega Ioane expected to miss time with MCL sprain
news.d: Ravens rookie guard Olaivavega Ioane is expected to miss time after spraining his MCL in Sunday's loss to the Bengals, sources told NFL Network.
